title: Is Sanskrit the Most Token-Efficient Language? A Quantitative Study using GPT, Gemini, and SentencePiece

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing token counts, characters per token (information density), and tokens per character (fragmentation cost) across parallel texts in Sanskrit, English, and Hindi using various tokenizers (GPT, Gemini, and SentencePiece) to measure the token tax and efficiency disparity for non-English languages.
